author: H. Esad Kay
status: Exploratory post-V2 supplement; original results were known; rules fixed before computing these additional results; not preregistered
bootstrap_calendar: Full protocol calendar, including missing endpoints and interior months; sample paired actual/nominal origin losses together in circular contiguous blocks
undefined_ratio_rule: A zero actual mean makes the relative reduction undefined. Report the count; suppress the ratio interval if any otherwise valid draw is undefined. Never drop such draws silently.
conditional_weights: Retain weights of the complete observed market/horizon cell. Conditional losses divide subgroup weighted losses by subgroup mass; contributions sum to the original total. No renesting within subgroups.
attrition_rule: Descriptive raw-case feature means by observed/late-archive/absent-key status; raw and eligible-nested-weight status shares. No imputed outcomes, inverse probability weights or claim of correcting selection bias.
frequency_pairs: Consecutive nominal-month pairs among the last 12 observations published no later than the primary origin, for the exact same core key. Exclude gap-spanning pairs.
benchmark_formula: f = past changed adjacent pairs / past adjacent pairs; q_h = 1 - (1-f)^h; forecast = last_price * exp(q_h * log(damped_trend / last_price))
benchmark_no_pair_fallback: Persistence; past_change_frequency is missing, shrinkage is zero, and fallback is explicit
benchmark_interpretation: Fixed heuristic shrinkage, not a calibrated event probability or optimized model; no tuning or new target-based selection
benchmark_sample: All original primary eligible cases, scored on the identical original observed targets; separate from the original five-model protocol
